scenes.text: A whole is shared into two equal pieces. What is one piece called? Let us think carefully. Equal parts must have the same size. Count how many equal pieces make the whole. The answer is one-half. Great work!

A whole is shared into four equal pieces. What is one piece called? Let us think carefully. Equal parts must have the same size. Count how many equal pieces make the whole. The answer is one-quarter. Great work!
Are unequal pieces called halves? Let us think carefully. Equal parts must have the same size. Count how many equal pieces make the whole. The answer is No. Great work!
How many equal halves make a whole? Let us think carefully. Equal parts must have the same size. Count how many equal pieces make the whole. The answer is Two. Great work!
